basis: Current Group17 report Section 5.3 and project-member clarification; this is not a new declaration signed by either reviewer.
applies_to: reviewer_declaration and review_form_state.declaration in those returns
report_aligned_description: Reviewers were responsible for the final ratings. AI assisted rubric-based checks of the assessments and suggested revisions, with the aim of limiting subjective variation. Reviewers decided which revisions to adopt.
limitations: This departs from the proposal’s independent human-review plan with no LLM judge. Its effect on bias was not evaluated, and fully independent blinded judgment cannot be established from the returns. The ratings provide descriptive evidence about the selected outputs.

interpretation.human_role: Responsibility for the final ratings and decisions on adopting proposed revisions rested with the reviewers.
interpretation.ai_role: AI-assisted assessment checks and revision suggestions; the archived returns also retain qualitative suggestions and accepted rating amendments.
interpretation.declarations: The original declaration fields record what was returned. They do not by themselves establish unaided independent judgment or certify actual blinding.
interpretation.source_packets: The original source packets preserve the instructions and blank declarations prepared before the returns. They describe the planned process and are not retrospective descriptions of the completed review.

preservation.original_returns_and_declarations: Retained byte-for-byte. Read them together with this dated clarification.
preservation.revision_history_and_confirmation_timest: Unchanged; no new reviewer confirmation is inferred or backdated.
preservation.statistics: Unchanged; no adjudication or score correction is introduced.
